train_gp_module: train a Gaussian process module using Cholesky decomposition to compute negative log marginal likelihood
test_gp_predictions: test Gaussian process predictions using trained Cholesky factor and cross-covariance matrices
test_gp_full_covariance: test Gaussian process predictions returning full covariance matrix instead of diagonal variance
review_gp_train_forward: review the GpTrainModule forward method that centers data and computes marginal likelihood
refactor_gp_test_module: refactor the GpTestModule to support additional noise variance in prediction variance
